leo2a4.name: Leopard 2A4
leo2a4.authority: Main ruled on 2026-10-29 (DECISIONS.md, ~11:00) that the release-264 2A4-era Leopards, rebuilt on the release Leopard 2 hull with the 2A4 turret derived from our 2A6 X (owner 2026-10-28: "update and cleanup our old designs ... and have them be the before variants basically") and unregistered from their later-variant 3D oracles on 2026-10-28 (Main: "where a rebuild's registered oracle shows a different (later) variant, unregister it"), qualify the geometry stage by this per-id photographic packet plus a shaded blind photo-critic PASS (lane evidence ~/cot-lanes/leo2a4-family-264-evidence, critic rounds on the SwiftShader Gallery stills). Numerical 3D comparison remains unverified. The plain 2A4 on the square 2A4 turret front (owner 2026-10-28: the even split), L/44.
leo2a4.envelopeBasis: Width is as built, 3.67 m over the fore skirt blocks; published 3.70 m including the track guards (tanks-encyclopedia, de.wikipedia) and 3.75 m (Slovak MoD). Length is the published 9.67 m gun forward of the Leopard 2A4 (Slovak MoD technical sheet; tanks-encyclopedia, de.wikipedia after Lobitz 2009; as built 9.70 m from the stern plate, which the fixture holds) plus the hull's stern rack behind the rear plate as built (0.36 m, its floor and rails; the photographs show stowage carried there). Tallest is the loader's MG3 on its ring as built (2.92 m); the published heights are 2.48 m to the turret roof and 2.84 m to the commander's sight (tanks-encyclopedia) and 2.79 m to the PERI R 17 (Slovak MoD); the fixture holds the roof (2.43 m as drawn) and the L/44's gun forward.
